diagnostic_sections: All LEDs are OFF at Controller
Oil and grease stains on motors and gearboxes

expected_triplets.corrective_action: ensure that the mains fuse (Q1) inside the Drive Module is not tripped

expected_triplets.symptom: All LEDs are OFF at Controller
expected_triplets.failure_mode: circuit breaker F6 is malfunctioning or open
expected_triplets.corrective_action: make sure circuit breaker F6 is closed in position 3

expected_triplets.symptom: All LEDs are OFF at Controller
expected_triplets.failure_mode: the system is not supplied with power
expected_triplets.corrective_action: make sure the system is supplied with power
make sure the circuit breaker in the Control Module has not been tripped
make sure the earth fault protection has not been tripped

expected_triplets.symptom: Oil and grease stains on motors and gearboxes
expected_triplets.failure_mode: leaking seal between gearbox and motor
expected_triplets.corrective_action: inspect all seals and gaskets between motor and gearbox

expected_triplets.symptom: Oil and grease stains on motors and gearboxes

expected_triplets.corrective_action: make sure the bearing has sufficient lubrication

expected_triplets.failure_mode: faulty power supply to the brake
expected_triplets.corrective_action: check the brake power supply to the collapsing motor

expected_triplets.failure_mode: brake contactor (K44) does not work correctly
expected_triplets.corrective_action: make sure the brake contactor is activated
check the Drive Module power supply to make sure 24V BRAKE voltage is OK

expected_human_review.reason: Fault-symptom sections legitimately list multiple probable causes per symptom and symptom-level action tables, so advisory items are expected; nothing may be blocking.
